```yaml
name: Docker CI Container Image

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main

jobs:
  build-and-format:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
    - name: Checkout code
      uses: actions/checkout@v2

    - name: Set up Go
      uses: actions/setup-go@v2
      with:
        go-version: '1.17'

    - name: Install dependencies
      run: |
        make dockerfile
        make format/yaml

    - name: Build Docker image
      run: |
        docker build . -t vald-dev-container:latest

    - name: Push Docker image
      if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'
      run: |
        echo "${{ secrets.DOCKER_PASSWORD }}" | docker login -u ${{ secrets.DOCKER_USERNAME }} --password-stdin
        docker tag vald-dev-container:latest gcr.io/vdaas/vald-dev-container:latest
        docker push gcr.io/vdaas/vald-dev-container:latest
```

This GitHub Actions workflow file will be placed at `.github/workflows/dockers-ci-container-image.yaml` in the `vdaas/vald` repository. It sets up a job named `build-and-format` that runs on every push or pull request to the `main` branch. The job checks out the code, sets up Go, installs dependencies using `make dockerfile` and `make format/yaml`, builds the Docker image, and pushes it to Google Container Registry (GCR) if the push is to the `main` branch.
